# Widgets, size classes, tokens and fonts

<!-- Generated by dist/sdk/gen-widget-docs.py from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

The small widgets, the size classes and metrics, the design tokens, the font roles and the style-literal lint.

## `widgets`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/widgets.rs`)

A few shared widgets over `Canvas`, so every app looks the same and every control has a name, a role and a large enough target.
Each one draws inside the rectangle it is given (never outside it, at any size class or text size) and returns what it used.
Radii, borders, gaps, shadows, glass and text sizes all come from the skin's tokens through `Metrics` (`m.tokens`, `m.gap`,
`m.size`): this file has no number of its own for them (a test scans for that).

### fn `glass_fill`

A fill as the skin wants it: translucent when the skin has glass, else the plain colour.

```rust
pub fn glass_fill(m: &Metrics, c: Color) -> Color
```

### fn `surface`

A raised surface: the skin's soft shadow (none when flat), then the fill. Returns the radius used.

```rust
pub fn surface(c: &mut dyn Canvas, th: &Theme, m: &Metrics, r: Rect, fill: Color, radius: Radius, raised: bool) -> f32
```

### fn `panel`

A panel or card of the skin (large corners, raised, glass when the skin has it).

```rust
pub fn panel(c: &mut dyn Canvas, th: &Theme, m: &Metrics, r: Rect)
```

### fn `button`

A button. Its height is at least the smallest target for the pointer in use. Returns the rectangle drawn.

```rust
pub fn button(c: &mut dyn Canvas, th: &Theme, m: &Metrics, r: Rect, label: &str, action: u32, primary: bool) -> Rect
```

### fn `row`

One row of a list: the text, a tint when selected, a name for the screen reader.

```rust
pub fn row(c: &mut dyn Canvas, th: &Theme, m: &Metrics, r: Rect, text: &str, selected: bool, action: u32) -> Rect
```

### fn `field`

A one-line text field showing `value` (or the `label` dimmed when empty), with a caret when focused.

```rust
pub fn field(c: &mut dyn Canvas, th: &Theme, m: &Metrics, r: Rect, label: &str, value: &str, focused: bool, action: u32) -> Rect
```

### fn `wallpaper_picker`

The wallpaper picker: one swatch per wallpaper with its name; swatch `i` has the action `base + i`. The chosen one has a ring.
Wraps to more lines when the width is small. Returns the rectangle used.

```rust
pub fn wallpaper_picker(c: &mut dyn Canvas, th: &Theme, m: &Metrics, r: Rect, current: wallpaper::Id, base: u32) -> Rect
```

### struct `Metrics`

What the app needs to know about its space, from one call.

```rust
pub struct Metrics
```

Public fields:

- `pub class: SizeClass`
- `pub area: Rect`
- `pub density: f32`: Device pixels per logical unit.
- `pub text_scale: f32`: The person's text size factor (1.0 = normal); multiply font sizes by it.
- `pub touch: bool`: The pointer is a finger: targets are at least [`MIN_TOUCH`].
- `pub tokens: Tokens`: The skin's numbers beyond colour: radii, borders, gaps, shadow, glass, glyph size, motion (the default is the plain skin).
- `pub type_style: TypeStyle`: The person's type choices (line height, letter spacing, family).

Methods:

- `pub fn new(w: f32, h: f32, density: f32, text_scale: f32, touch: bool) -> Metrics`
- `pub fn with_tokens(mut self, tokens: Tokens) -> Metrics`
- `pub fn with_type(mut self, t: TypeStyle) -> Metrics`
- `pub fn text_style(&self, role: FontRole, ty: TypeRole) -> TextSpec`: What to draw a font role with: the canvas style and the person's size, line height and spacing.
- `pub fn size(&self, role: TypeRole) -> f32`: The font size of a text role, with the person's text size applied.
- `pub fn leading(&self, size: f32) -> f32`: The distance from one baseline to the next for text of this size.
- `pub fn gap(&self, s: Space) -> f32`: A gap or padding of the skin's spacing scale.
- `pub fn radius(&self, r: Radius) -> f32`: A corner radius of the skin's shape scale.
- `pub fn line(&self, l: Line) -> f32`: A border width of the skin's edge scale.
- `pub fn em(&self, n: f32) -> f32`: A width that is a number of text sizes wide (a label button), so it grows with the person's text size.
- `pub fn min_target(&self) -> f32`: The smallest height of a pressable thing here.
- `pub fn font(&self, size: f32) -> f32`: A font size with the person's text size applied.
- `pub fn gutter(&self) -> f32`: Side padding that grows with the space.

## `tokens`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/tokens.rs`)

Design tokens beyond colour (F-SDK-120): the numbers a skin sets and the SDK widgets and apps read. A [`Tokens`] is made from a
Look (its `surface`, its `motion` and the theme's focus ring) and holds only numbers, so a widget never has a radius, a border
width, a gap, a shadow, a glyph size or a duration of its own: it asks for a step of the scale and the skin decides what the step is.

| scale | steps | what a skin changes |
|---|---|---|
| [`Radius`] | `Sm`, `Md`, `Lg` | `shape`: sharp, soft (what the SDK drew before skins), round, pill |
| [`Line`] | `Hair`, `Normal`, `Thick` | `edge`: thin, regular, heavy |
| [`Space`] | `Xxs` .. `Xl` | `spacing`: tight, normal, airy (a factor on the base steps) |
| shadow | spread and strength | `elevation`: flat, low, high |
| glass | on or off, blur radius | `glass`, `blur` (the canvas has no blur operation yet: a renderer draws the translucent fill) |
| glyph | one size | `glyph_size` |
| motion | `Fast`, `Normal`, `Slow` in ms | `motion`: reduced gives 0 (nothing animates) |
| focus ring | one width | the theme's `ring` factor |

### enum `Radius`

Corner radius steps (small controls and fields, buttons and rows, cards and panels).

```rust
pub enum Radius
```

Variants:

- `Sm`
- `Md`
- `Lg`

### enum `Line`

Border and rule widths.

```rust
pub enum Line
```

Variants:

- `Hair`
- `Normal`
- `Thick`

### enum `Space`

Gaps and paddings, smallest to largest.

```rust
pub enum Space
```

Variants:

- `Xxs`
- `Xs`
- `Sm`
- `Md`
- `Lg`
- `Xl`

### enum `Speed`

Animation durations.

```rust
pub enum Speed
```

Variants:

- `Fast`
- `Normal`
- `Slow`

### struct `Tokens`

```rust
pub struct Tokens
```

Public fields:

- `pub glass: bool`
- `pub blur: f32`
- `pub reduced_motion: bool`

Methods:

- `pub fn of(look: &iyakki_uikit::look::Look) -> Tokens`: The tokens of a Look: its `surface`, its `motion` and the theme's focus ring.
- `pub fn radius(&self, r: Radius) -> f32`
- `pub fn radius_for(&self, r: Radius, h: f32) -> f32`: The radius for a thing of height `h`: never more than half of it (a pill is a half-circle end, not a bulge).
- `pub fn line(&self, l: Line) -> f32`
- `pub fn space(&self, s: Space) -> f32`
- `pub fn shadow_spread(&self) -> f32`: How far the soft shadow of a raised surface spreads; 0 is flat (draw none).
- `pub fn shadow_alpha(&self) -> u8`: The alpha of a shadow colour (0 when flat).
- `pub fn glyph(&self) -> f32`: The size of a glyph or small icon in a widget.
- `pub fn focus_width(&self) -> f32`: The width of the focus ring: twice the line, times the theme's ring factor (High contrast draws it thick).
- `pub fn duration_ms(&self, s: Speed) -> u32`: Milliseconds an animation of this speed takes; 0 when the person asked for reduced motion.
- `pub fn animates(&self) -> bool`

## `typeface`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/typeface.rs`)

Font abilities of the SDK (F-SKIN-04): the family the person chose, line height, letter spacing, tabular figures, the roles an app
asks for (it never names a file), and what the bundled fonts cover per script. The numbers and words here are plain data: no font
file is read in this module, so the client engine links it too.

What is bundled (legal/assets.txt): DejaVu Sans, Sans Bold and Sans Mono (the default), Liberation Sans, Sans Bold and Mono, and Noto
Sans for Arabic, Bengali, Devanagari, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, Hebrew, Kannada, Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu and Thai. Latin, Greek and Cyrillic
come from DejaVu and Liberation. **No CJK font and no dyslexia-friendly face is bundled**, so none is offered: a Han, Kana or Hangul
letter is reported as not covered ([`TypeStyle::uncovered`]) and draws as the toolkit's fallback box. A font with a licence entry is
the way to add either.

### enum `Family`

The family of the interface text, as the person chose it (their choice is kept by the core, `iyakki_uikit::fonts`).

```rust
pub enum Family
```

Variants:

- `Default`: The platform default (DejaVu Sans).
- `DejaVu`
- `Liberation`

Methods:

- `pub fn key(self) -> &'static str`

- `pub fn css(self) -> &'static str`: The family name a browser draws with, with the metric-compatible fallbacks (a browser has the same files only when the page loads them; otherwise the first installed name wins).

## `lint`  (`crates/iyakki-ui-sdk/src/lint.rs`)

A scan for styling numbers written into widget or app code (F-SDK-121). Colours, radii, borders, gaps, shadow sizes, glyph sizes and
font sizes come from the skin's tokens (`Metrics::tokens`, `Metrics::gap`, `Metrics::size`); a number of 3.0 or more written in a
drawing function is almost always one of those, so a test of every widget file and every SDK app runs [`style_literals`] on its
source. What it lets through: numbers under 3 (halves, doubles, ratios), a line that declares a `const` (a named proportion), the
argument of `em(` (a width in text sizes), comments, strings and everything from the first `#[cfg(test)]` on.

### fn `style_literals`

The lines of `src` (1-based, with the text) that hold a decimal number of 3.0 or more outside the places listed above.

```rust
pub fn style_literals(src: &str) -> Vec<String>
```

### fn `events_unhandled`

An app that registers for events must handle the `missed` marker and look at `late` (docs/sdk/events.md). Returns what it lacks, from the
app's source (everything before the first `#[cfg(test)]`): empty when the app does not use events or handles both.

```rust
pub fn events_unhandled(src: &str) -> Vec<&'static str>
```
